designationHistory.indexText: President Theodore Roosevelt created the Umatilla National Forest from the Heppner National Forest and part of the Blue Mountains National Forest in Oregon.
designationHistory.note: The executive order text was not located online. FS-612 and the 1944 WPA list of executive orders (compiled from the orders) agree on EO 815 of 1908-06-13; Davis gives the effective date, July 1, 1908. The scanned WPA list reads 'June 18', but its orders 812 and 818 are dated June 10 and June 15, so 815 falls on June 13; FS-612 (1997 and 2012) gives June 13.
